text:
Type: square cube shelving unit
Use: storing books, baskets and records, dividing a room; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white painted particleboard, thick smooth panels
Colors: bright white
Shape: compact square box divided into four equal open cubes, thick flat frame, open back, sits directly on the floor, crisp edges, bold grid look, medium visual weight
Feel: tidy, graphic, versatile, fresh
Goes with: woven or fabric storage boxes, light wood, colorful accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms, small apartments
